name: RemNote JSON Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Open Import report.md in the output folder to see each missing reference and unsupported item.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. RemNote JSON Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
